title: Two GO-BGC Argo float lifetimes and metadata
publisher: Argo / GO-BGC / NOAA AOML / IFREMER GDAC
license_or_access_terms: GO-BGC freely reusable with acknowledgment; Argo citation retained
deterministic_selection_rule: All twelve top-level NetCDF profile, synthetic-profile, trajectory, metadata and technical files for the two fixed floats. Preserve raw and adjusted variables and quality flags.

measurement_dates.description: All twelve top-level files frozen at retrieval for floats 5906483 and 5906486; JULD/profile dates and DATE_UPDATE fields preserve observation/update dates independently.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: GDAC profile/trajectory products with delayed-mode and real-time processing. Adjusted and unadjusted values represent alternative versions of the same measurements. GDAC files may change after retrieval.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Two floats do not establish ocean-wide transfer. Oxygen/nutrient sensor response and QC can mimic physical relationships. The GO-BGC FAQ and current citation policy are included; an obsolete optional citation URL returned 404 before the current link was located.
